written.myAnswer: Energy must be absorbed to overcome the forces holding the bonded atoms together.
Bond formation lowers the atoms’ energy, so energy is released as they form a more stable state.

Nitrogen and oxygen do not react appreciably under normal conditions because breaking their strong bonds requires a large energy input. The reaction is endothermic, and lightning supplies the energy needed for it to occur; without that energy input, the reaction stops.
The match supplies the activation energy needed to start the reaction. Combustion then releases heat, which keeps the reaction going until one or both reactants are used up.

Heat is energy transferred between a system and its surroundings. Enthalpy is a property representing the system’s energy content; at constant pressure, the enthalpy change equals the heat absorbed or released.
Lipids are energy-rich fuels and stores in the body. Their metabolism releases energy, including heat that helps keep the body warm.
Cooking can make food softer and easier to digest, improve its taste, and kill harmful microorganisms. Some foods, such as many fruits, can be eaten raw without cooking.
Fireworks are spectacular because their reactions release light, heat and sound. Metal salts produce different colours, while oxidising agents help the reactions occur.
